messages:
peter (docs): Quick sync — drafting the 'Region & Residency' doc for public docs. Core asks: make clear which regions support residency add-on, how to enroll, and SDK examples. Putting a checklist in the PR.
anna (sales): Please highlight that customers in APAC often ask about both availability and residency; we should be explicit which regions are 'available' vs 'residency-enabled'.
rui (infra): Current state: inference endpoints live in: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, eu-north-1, ap-southeast-1. Residency add-on (contractual) currently available in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 only.
peter (docs): Noted. I'll add a separate "Residency enrollment" section with steps. Any standard phrase for the contract requirement?
maria (legal): Use: "Data residency is provided via the Data Residency add-on and is subject to a signed agreement. Residency covers model outputs, logs, and billing metadata when enrolled; it does not guarantee model weights placement unless explicitly contracted." Keep it conservative.
tom (sdk): SDK note: show both region constructor param and env var. Example JS: ```js // set via constructor
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'eu-west-1' });
await client.generate(...);
// or env
process.env.REDWOOD_REGION = 'eu-west-1';
``` Python: ```py import os
os.environ['REDWOOD_REGION'] = 'eu-west-1'
client = Redwood()
``` Also include the error text: `Error: unsupported region 'ap-east-1' — contact support to request region access.`
peter (docs): Good — I'll include the error example. Also adding curl example for switching endpoints: `curl "https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
rui (infra): Small infra caveat to call out: telemetry collected for platform health (metrics, anonymized traces) may flow to control plane in us-west-2 unless the customer opts into full residency and dedicated plane. Mention KMS support: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments; hosted residency uses our managed keys unless otherwise contracted.
maria (legal): Add link to SOC2 & DPA docs and a note: "Encryption at rest and in transit is provided; customers requiring specific key control should contact sales for Private deployment options."
peter (docs): I'll add a migration snippet for customers moving from global endpoint to region endpoints, plus a short FAQ entry: "What happens if my region isn't listed?" -> "Contact sales/solutions to request dedicated capacity or enroll in upcoming rollout."
deploy-bot: docs preview generated for PR #4567 — https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4567 (lint ok)
anna (sales): Can you add a tiny table row for planned regions: ap-east-1 (Q3 GA), sa-east-1 (pilot)? just label as 'planned' not guaranteed.
rui (infra): Sure — mark as planned with note: "subject to Dedicated capacity commitments and hardware availability."
peter (docs): I'll open the PR in ~15m and tag @maria @tom @rui for review. Thanks everyone.
